**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Guard the ancestor walk against cycles**

If a layout contains a cycle of ancestors without a COLUMN, this loop never terminates. For example, two ROW components that reference each other, with a chart under one of them, cause `rendered_width()` to hang. This also affects sending a layout with chart sizing hints: `_check_before_sending()` runs sizing before structural validation, so the new walk prevents the existing cycle validator from reporting the invalid layout. Track visited component IDs and stop on a repeated ancestor so validation can handle the cycle.

AGENTS.md reference: [AGENTS.md:L122-L124](https://github.com/jailtoncarlos/superset-api-plus/blob/98008c9968c849a1465a2a98380e7f823b269692/AGENTS.md#L122-L124)
